premise: 1884, a fictional Colorado railway town. A freight receipt conflicts with a station timetable. Procedural frontier investigation with outdoor pursuit; firearms and horses are not automatically granted.

skills.name: Electrical Repair
skills.use: Inspect permitted telegraph apparatus; does not grant radio/computer expertise.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

skills.name: Track
skills.use: Follow a usable physical trail; weather and surfaces limit evidence.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

skills.name: Mechanical Repair
skills.use: Inspect a mechanical fault after access; cannot establish a human motive by itself.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

skills.name: Persuade
skills.use: Ask for a specific favor or explanation; a timetable is not a confession.
skills.limit: No new points or bonus dice; occupational eligibility remains in the linked creation specification.

items.name: Station message copy
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Compare the sender, recipient and time notation with a permitted station log.
items.effect: Shows the recorded message exactly as supplied; no guarantee it is truthful.
items.limits: One employer-provided copy; access covers this message only.
items.upkeep: Keep dry; if damaged, request a clerk's recollection at a delay cost.
items.substitute: Ask the clerk to identify the destination and uncertainty orally.

items.name: Track-inspection sketch
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Mark a public inspection route and compare observed landmarks.
items.effect: Helps communicate locations; does not locate tracks or grant a Navigate bonus.
items.limits: One fictional employer sketch, not a surveyed map or travel ticket.
items.upkeep: Update only observed landmarks; replace through the station office.
items.substitute: Travel with the local inspector on the public path.

items.name: Repair kit
items.acquisition: Optional equipment supplied at the relevant scene by its fictional custodian; not added to starting cards.
items.price_basis: Explicit loan or supply allocation, no purchase or historically asserted price.
items.procedure: Inspect an isolated, nonoperating lock or latch with the owner's permission.
items.effect: Enables ordinary repair work under core skill rules; no automatic success or damage bonus.
items.limits: One loan; does not authorize railway operation, sabotage or work on moving equipment.
items.upkeep: Return parts after use; a missing part requires a station mechanic.
items.substitute: Have the authorized mechanic inspect it and report findings.
